bhamayati：ဘမယတိ （ကာ） （√ဘမ်+ဏယ）
လည်စေ၏။
DOP: 1 bhamati pr. 3 sg. [ S. bhramati], 1. roams about; moves to and fro; rolls around; turns, whirls round (intrans.); Vv 64:20 (imāsu vīṇāsu … pavajjamānāsu … ~anti kaññā; Vv-a 282, 1 : ~anti naccaṃ dassentiyo sañcaranti); Pv 41:6 (~anti khuppipāsāya, Be so; Ce, Ee caranti; Se maranti); Th 963 (ye ye lābhaṃ labhissanti … te te va anusikkhantā ~issanti asaṃyatā, Ce so; Be, Ee bhajissanti; Se gamissanti; Th-a III 87, 10 foll. : ~issantī ti … rājakulādīni sevantā paribbhamissanti, bhajissantī ti vā pāṭho, sevissantī ti attho); Ja I 414, 7* (icchāhatassa posassa cakkaṃ ~ati matthake) = III 207, 16* = IV 4, 24* (5, 23´ : idaṃ cakkaṃ matthakaṃ nipiṃsamānaṃ idāni kumbhakāracakkaṃ viya matthake ~atī ti attho); III 289, 4* (tasasi ~asi lenam icchasi; 289, 22´ : maraṇabhayena uttasasi ten’ eva kilamanto ~asi); V 106, 13´ (~eyya); VI 559, 31* (tyajja putte apassantyā ~ate viya assamo; 560, 24´ : kulālacakkaṃ viya ~ati); Vism 260, 28 (akkhīni pītakāni honti ~anti); 579, 4* ([bhavacakkaṃ] anavaṭṭhitaṃ ~ati; 581, 14 : punappunaṃ parivattanato ~ati); Spk II 208, 18 (ummattakasuṇakhena daṭṭho puriso anavaṭṭhito va ~ati); Mp I 448, 10 (ayya ajja te sakaladivasaṃ kilantatāya akkhīni maññe ~antī ti); — part.pr. ( a ) bhamanta 1 , mf (~antī) n. , Ap 559, 20 (ito tato ~antī, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se gacchantī); ( b ) bhamamāna, mfn. , Vism 581, 16 ; — aor. 3 sg. bhami, Ja V 291, 3 (cakkaṃ … sakiṃ āviddham eva yāva majjhantikātikkamā ~i yeva, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr tikkam āgami yeva); 3 pl. bhamiṃsu, Ja III 130, 14 (nalāṭe suriyātapena pahaṭamatte akkhīni ~iṃsu); Dhp-a III 116, 4 ; — absol. ( a ) bhamitvā 1 , Bv-a 263, 18 (pāsādo kulālacakkam iva ~itvā); ( b ) bhamitvāna, Ap 607, 19 ( Be, Ce so; Ee bhamitvā va; Se gamitvā); — pp bhanta , mfn. [ S. bhrānta], wandering, straying; moving about unsteadily, staggering, reeling; whirling round; perplexed, confused; S V 369, 12 foll. (Kapilavatthuṃ pavisanto ~ena pi hatthinā samāgacchāmi ~ena pi assena … ~ena pi rathena … ~ena pi purisena samāgacchāmi); A III 232, 21 (udapatto vāterito calito ~o ūmijāto); Dhp 222 (yo ve uppatitaṃ kodhaṃ rathaṃ ~aṃ va dhāraye); Sn 816 (yānaṃ ~aṃ va taṃ loke hīnam āhu puthujjanaṃ; Nidd I 145, 23 : taṃ ~aṃ yānaṃ adantaṃ akāritaṃ avinītaṃ uppathaṃ gaṇhāti); Pv 26:7 (chātā pamucchitā ~ā bhūmiyaṃ paṭisumbhitā; Pv-a 174, 3 : ~ā ti paribbhamantā); 51:1 (migo ~o va dhāvasi; Pv-a 284, 18 : ~-migo viya ito c’ ito ca dhāvasi); Ja V 215, 13* (nārī migī ~ā v’ udikkhati); Nidd I 220, 4 (cetaso vikkhepo ~-ttaṃ cittassa idaṃ vuccati uddhaccaṃ) ≠ Dhs 429 ≠ Vibh 168, 34 ; Bv 2:170 (ubbiggā tasitā bhītā ~ā; Bv-a 116, 15 : ~ā ti phandanamānasā vibbhantacittā ti attho, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ~-mānasā); Paṭis-a 585, 28 (~-tāvasena); — neg. abhanta, mfn. , not whirling round; not perplexed; Nidd I 353, 12 (samuddo … aluḷito abhanto vūpasanto); Ap 321, 29 (abhantaṃ hoti me cittaṃ); — fpp bhamitabba, mfn. , Spk II 208, 18 ; — caus. pr. 3 sg. ( a ) bhamati , makes spin; whirls round (trans.); ? Dhp 371 (mā te kāmaguṇe ~assu cittaṃ, Ce, Ee, Se so, possibly wr; Be ramessu; PDhp 33: mā vo kāmaguṇā bhrameṃsu cittaṃ; Dhp-a IV 109, 16 : pañcavidhe ca te kāmaguṇe cittaṃ mā ~atu, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be pañcavidhe ca kāmaguṇe te cittaṃ mā ramessu; cf GDhp pp. 194–95; K.R. Norman, 1997, p. 151 ); — part.pr. bhamanta 2 , mf (~antī) n. , Ja I 414, 15´ ; V 478, 13 (bhamarikaṃ ~anto viya, Ce, Ee so; Be bhamikaṃ; Se bhamaracakkaṃ) = Cp-a 250, 32 ( eds so ); — absol. bhamitvā 2 , Ap-a 126, 20 (bodhisatto taṃ [mallayodhaṃ] ukkhipitvā ākase ~itvā bhūmiya pātento); — caus. pr. 3 sg. ( b ) bhameti , ~ayati , makes spin; whirls round; Sn 680 (dussaṃ gahetvā ~ayatha kiṃ paṭicca, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se ramayatha); Bv 1:22 (~enti celāni ca ambare tadā; Bv-a 38, 11 : ~ayanti vatthāni); — part.pr. ( a ) bhamenta, mfn. , Pj II 224, 7 (vātā … chadaniṭṭhakā ākāse ~entā; = Spk I 323, 5 : Se ~antā; Be, Ce, Ee vidhamentā); ( b ) bhamayanta, mfn. , Bv-a 289, 14 (saraṃ ~ayanto); — aor. 3 pl. bhamayiṃsu, Dāṭh 3:67; — absol. ( a ) bhametvā, Ja IV 82, 7 (Cānuraṃ … sīsamatthake ~etvā); Mhv 23:80; ( b ) bhamayitvā, Vism 142, 31 (kumbhakārassa daṇḍappahārena cakkaṃ ~ayitvā bhājanaṃ karontassa) = Paṭis-a 182, 15 ; — pp bhamita, mfn. , Paṭis-a 28, 25* (~itamhi cakkayante); — ( c ) bhamāpayati, makes go round; Mhv 29:51(bhamāpayituṃ āraddho).

DOP: bhamukā f. , ~a, m. ( and bhamukha?), f. [ cf BHS bhrū̆mukha], an eyebrow; Abh 259 (bhū … ~o bhamu); Vin III 53, 13 (akkhiṃ vā nikhaṇissāmi ~aṃ vā ukkhipissāmi … tena nimittena taṃ bhaṇḍaṃ avaharā ti); Thī 256 (cittakārasukatā va lekhitā sobhare su ~ā pure mama); Ja VI 413, 23 (eko ~aṃ ukkhipi); Cp 2:5:4 (khandhe nalāṭe ~e mutteti ohaneti taṃ); Dhp-a I 74, 19 (… kaṇṇā ~ā … kesā sobhanā ti); Sp 1211, 12 (~āyaṃ … lomaṃ palitaṃ); Pj II 457, 16 (~aṃ vā ukkhipissāmi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee bhamukhaṃ, perhaps wr ); Cp-a 32, 17 (subbhūrū ti sundarehi ~ehi ūrūhi ca samannāgate); — °’- antare , between the eyebrows; D III 144, 27 (mahāpurisassa uṇṇā ~e jātā hoti odātā mudutūlasannibhā) ≠ M II 137, 8 (Ps III 385, 1 ; dvinnaṃ bhamukānaṃ vemajjhe nāsikāmatthake yeva); Sn 1022; Thī 232 (~e tiṭṭhāmi tiṭṭhantiṃ maṃ na dakkhasi; ≠ S I 132, 12* : pakhumantarikāyaṃ pi tiṭṭhantiṃ) ≠ Ap 556, 22 (°’-antarikāyaṃ pi tiṭṭhantiṃ, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce pakhumantarikāyaṃ pi); — °’- ukkhepa , m. , raising of the eyebrows; Mhv 65:43 (~-mattena, Ee so; Be bhamukkhipanamattena); — subhamukha , mfn. , with beautiful eyebrows; Ja IV 18, 17´ (subbhū ti subhamukhā, eds so; or subha-mukhā?); — see also bhamu, bhū 3 .
